skills.name: mine-a-series
skills.description: Mine a whole vein/tree (a SERIES of blocks) the one right way
skills.text: To mine a whole object (vein/tree): 1) scan_blocks to get its handle. 2) run_method with a for_each over the object's members, then collect: {"steps":[{"op":"for_each","set":{"op":"members","handle":"obj:..."},"as":"c","body":[{"action":"set_block","args":{"target":{"kind":"cell","pos":{"from":"c"}},"block":"minecraft:air","navigate":true,"allowModify":true,"breakThrough":true}}]},{"action":"collect","args":{"radius":8}}]}. NEVER loop set_block by hand for a series (not reusable, not assertable). After mining, get_inventory to verify the drops landed.

skills.name: chopping
skills.description: Chop a tree and collect the logs
skills.text: scan_blocks {match:'#minecraft:logs'} -> go_to the handle (range 2) -> run_method for_each members -> set_block air -> collect. Logs drop item entities; always collect or the logs never enter the inventory.

skills.name: craft-a-pickaxe
skills.description: From logs to a wooden pickaxe
skills.text: logs -> spruce_planks (craft 12 = 3 logs) -> stick (craft 4 = 2 planks) -> crafting_table (craft 1 = 4 planks) -> place the table next to solid ground -> craft wooden_pickaxe at the table (3 planks + 2 sticks). craft `count` is the desired RESULT amount. lookup_recipe gives ALL recipes (2x2 and 3x3) with real ingredients.
